caption: The drawing features a woman standing and facing forward, wearing a peach-colored, floor-length dress with puffed short sleeves and a wide, rounded neckline trimmed with a darker decorative edge. The dress has a fitted bodice with a matching peach belt at the waist, adorned with symmetrical dark brown geometric patterns. Similar dark brown geometric patterns form a continuous border near the hem of the skirt. She wears long, pale gray gloves that reach above her elbows and white shoes with pink decorations. The woman's hair is black, parted in the center, and styled in smooth sections on both sides of her head. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller depiction of the same woman shown from behind, displaying the back of the dress and hairstyle. The background is plain and off-white. The name "Edith Turner" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Doll: "Rachel"
